summary: The proposal is exceptionally well-structured and meets all structural, writing, citation, and formatting requirements. The problem section clearly identifies actors and their negative consequences without presenting solutions; the motivation is visionary and does not repeat the problem; the four objectives are in action form with single verbs and each has a detailed two-paragraph subsection. All three UML figures (use case, object, component) are properly referenced and have extensive informative captions. The bibliography contains 12 peer-reviewed publications in consistent alpha citation style, with citations placed before the full stop. The schedule uses six 4-week iterations with vertically integrated, measurable deliverables and no requirements or writing sprints. The AI transparency statement is specific, first-person, names the tool and model, lists purposes and scope, and confirms the author checked all generated content. No issues requiring correction were identified.
